title: The righteous and elect shall be strong as fiery lights
summary_md: When Enoch is carried to the resting-places of the righteous he sees them already shining in the presence of the Elect One: *And I saw his dwelling-place under the wings of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits. And all the righteous and elect before Him shall be strong as fiery lights, And their mouth shall be full of blessing, And their lips extol the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And righteousness before Him shall never fail, [And uprightness shall never fail before Him.]* (1 Enoch 39:7). Daniel was shown the same light on the same company at the resurrection: *And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.* (Daniel 12:3). And Yahusha (Jesus) puts it at the harvest, after the tares that were sown among the wheat have been gathered out of the field: *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* (Matthew 13:43). Enoch does not count these righteous as a few; he says they *shall be without number before Him for ever and ever* (1 Enoch 39:6), and that their shining is the fruit of being kept under the wings of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, not of any merit of their own. The light the wise carry in Daniel and the sun the righteous become in Matthew is the same fiery strength Enoch saw on the elect before the throne, and it belongs to those who stay in the covenant way until the harvest.
note: 39:9 quote was invented; re-formed on 39:7 (righteous and elect as fiery lights), 39:6 callback; dropped the Psalm 114 / 51:4 tail which no longer sits in ch 39.

title: The four presences around the throne and the accuser cast out
summary_md: Enoch's vision of the throne-room ends with the host that never sleeps and the four who stand nearest: *Those who sleep not bless Thee: they stand before Thy glory and bless, praise, and extol, saying: “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: He filleth the earth with spirits.”* (1 Enoch 39:12), and then *And on the four sides of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits I saw four presences, different from those that sleep not, and I learnt their names: for the angel that went with me made known to me their names, and showed me all the hidden things.* (1 Enoch 40:2). John is shown the same four about the same throne, with the same cry on their lips: *And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Yahuah Elohim (Lord God) Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.* (Revelation 4:8). One of the four has a particular office, and Enoch hears it at work: *And I heard the fourth voice fending off the Satans and forbidding them to come before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits to accuse them who dwell on the earth.* (1 Enoch 40:7). That is the office whose victory John proclaims, *the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our Elohim (God) day and night.* (Revelation 12:10), the accuser who in Zechariah's court stood *at his right hand to resist* the high priest (Zechariah 3:1). The third voice prays for those on the earth, and Tobit knows that ministry by name: *I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels, which present the prayers of the saints, and which go in and out before the glory of the Holy One.* (Tobit 12:15). The angel names all four for Enoch, Michael, Raphael, Gabriel and Phanuel (1 Enoch 40:9). They are created servants who stand around the throne and plead for men; none of them sits on it.
note: 39:11/39:16/39:18 do not exist in Charles; re-anchored the quotes on 39:12, 40:2, 40:7, 40:9.

title: Thousands of thousands before the Yahuah of Spirits
summary_md: Enoch is lifted into the throne-room and tries to count the host: *And after that I saw thousands of thousands and ten thousand times ten thousand, I saw a multitude beyond number and reckoning, who stood before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 40:1). Daniel sees the same court convene for judgement and uses the same numbers: *A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.* (Daniel 7:10). John, carried up in the Spirit, hears the very same count around the throne, *the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;* (Revelation 5:11), and watches the whole assembly go down on its face: *And all the angels stood round about the throne, and about the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped Elohim (God),* (Revelation 7:11). Enoch, Daniel and John each stood in the one court and counted the one host, and all three gave up counting at the same place.
note: 40:1 re-quoted from the live verse (the old words were a paraphrase); prose kept.

title: The four presences and the voice of praise
summary_md: Around the throne stand four faces lifting praise: *And on the four sides of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits I saw four presences, different from those that sleep not, and I learnt their names: for the angel that went with me made known to me their names, and showed me all the hidden things.* (1 Enoch 40:2), *And I heard the voices of those four presences as they uttered praises before Yahuah (God) of glory.* (1 Enoch 40:3), *The first voice blesses Yahuah (God) of Spirits for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 40:4). Isaiah was shown the same attendants at the same throne, and their whole work is praise: *Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.* (Isaiah 6:2). Their cry, *And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): the whole earth is full of his glory.* (Isaiah 6:3), is the first of Enoch's four voices, blessing the Yahuah of Spirits for ever. John records the matching scene of the four living creatures and the host ringed about the throne in ceaseless worship (Revelation 7:11). The four presences are the seraphim of the temple vision, seen by another prophet from another angle.
note: draft stood; smoothed the closing sentence.

title: The second voice blesses the Elect One
summary_md: The second of the four voices is reserved for One who is blessed beside the Yahuah of Spirits: *And the second voice I heard blessing the Elect One and the elect ones who hang upon Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 40:5). The Elect One is the Formed Son who proceeds from the Head of Days, chosen and named before creation, blessed with the Father and ordered under Him, and this same book names him a few chapters on: *This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness ... because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him* (1 Enoch 46:3), *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.* (1 Enoch 48:2). Isaiah had already announced him as the chosen one on whom the Spirit rests: *Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him* (Isaiah 42:1). When Daniel sees him brought to the throne he keeps the comparison, *behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days* (Daniel 7:13): Daniel sees one like the Son of Adam, because the one he saw would take on flesh while remaining the Formed, and Enoch names that same one the Elect One. John sees him among the lampstands with the same comparison, *one like unto the Son of Adam* (Revelation 1:13). The elect ones who hang upon the Yahuah of Spirits are his people, chosen with him before they ever heard his voice.
note: 40:11 is not in Charles; dropped it. 46:3 and 48:2 stand as quoted in the old text (not in this packet's chapters beyond 46/48 which are supplied).

title: The third voice intercedes; the fourth fends off the satans
summary_md: Two of the four voices do heaven's work for the people of the earth: *And the third voice I heard pray and intercede for those who dwell on the earth and supplicate in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 40:6), *And I heard the fourth voice fending off the Satans and forbidding them to come before Yahuah (God) of Spirits to accuse them who dwell on the earth.* (1 Enoch 40:7). Zechariah is shown that very accusing satan standing against a man before the angel of Yahuah: *And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of Yahuah (LORD), and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.* (Zechariah 3:1), and John hears the day the accuser is silenced for good: *for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our Elohim (God) day and night.* (Revelation 12:10). The voice that prays for men is not a stray piece of angel-lore either. Raphael names himself as the one who carries prayers up: *I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels, which present the prayers of the saints, and which go in and out before the glory of the Holy One.* (Tobit 12:15), and the same prayer rises as incense in John's throne-room: *And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer ... that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.* (Revelation 8:3). Above every created intercessor stands the Son of Adam himself, who *maketh intercession for us* (Romans 8:34); the angels' prayer points toward him.
note: 40:6 re-quoted; 'interceding' in prose now reads 'the voice that prays for men'.

title: Michael, Raphael, Gabriel, Phanuel — the four named
summary_md: Enoch's guide names the four presences for him: *And he said to me: ‘This first is Michael, the merciful and long- suffering: and the second, who is set over all the diseases and all the wounds of the children of men, is Raphael: and the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel: and the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is named Phanuel.’* (1 Enoch 40:9). Michael is the prince Daniel knows, the one who stands for the people: *And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people* (Daniel 12:1), and Jude calls him the archangel who would not rail against the accuser on his own authority, *Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses ... but said, Yahuah (Lord) rebuke thee.* (Jude 1:9), which is the merciful and long-suffering Michael of Enoch's vision. Raphael, set over all the diseases and wounds of the children of men, is the healer Tobit met, who also carries the prayers of the saints: *I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels, which present the prayers of the saints* (Tobit 12:15). And this ordering of named ministers over the works of creation is the order Jubilees records from the first day: *the angels of the spirit of the winds, and the angels of the spirit of the clouds, and of darkness, and of snow and of hail* (Jubilees 2:2). The four are the canon's own named ministers, not a mythology Enoch brought in from outside.
note: 'sickness' in prose aligned to the live verse's 'diseases and wounds'.

title: The hidden things shown to Enoch and kept for the elect
summary_md: The angel who walks with Enoch through the throne-room does not keep him at the door; he opens the storehouses: *And on the four sides of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits I saw four presences, different from those that sleep not, and I learnt their names: for the angel that went with me made known to me their names, and showed me all the hidden things.* (1 Enoch 40:2), and when Enoch asks who the four are, it is *the angel of peace who went with me, who showed me everything that is hidden* (1 Enoch 40:8) who answers. The Torah had already said where the secret things live and to whom the revealed things are given: *The secret things belong unto Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God): but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.* (Deuteronomy 29:29). The storehouses Enoch is walked past are the ones Yahuah asks Job about, *Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail* (Job 38:22), and it is the Son of Adam, the Elect One, *who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden* (1 Enoch 46:3). Yahusha (Jesus) promises his own the same unsealing: *Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.* (Matthew 10:26). The secrets are not hoarded. They are kept for the righteous and elect, the people chosen together with the Elect One, and shown to them in their season.
note: 40:13/40:21/40:24 do not exist in Charles; thread re-formed on 40:2 and 40:8 (the angel shows Enoch the hidden things), kept Job 38:22, 46:3, Matt 10:26; added Deut 29:29 from the index; dropped Daniel 2:22 and 1 Cor 2:10 (not in the index).

title: The actions of men weighed in the balance
summary_md: Enoch is shown the most sober secret of heaven: *And after that I saw all the secrets of the heavens, and how the kingdom is divided, and how the actions of men are weighed in the balance.* (1 Enoch 41:1). The same scale hangs over Belshazzar's feast: *TEKEL; Thou art weighed in the balances, and art found wanting.* (Daniel 5:27), the writing on the wall that reckons a king's deeds against the standard he had spurned. The balance belongs to the Creator and not to men who would rig it: *A just weight and balance are the LORD'S: all the weights of the bag are his work.* (Proverbs 16:11). And the weighing is no figure of speech for the conscience, because later in these same Parables the angel shows Enoch the measuring of creation itself: *And the chambers of the winds, and how the winds are divided, and how they are weighed, and (how) the portals of the winds are reckoned, each according to the power of the wind, and the power of the lights of the moon, and according to the power that is fitting: and the divisions of the stars according to their names, and how all the divisions are divided.* (1 Enoch 60:12). A Creator who weighs the winds will weigh the deeds of men. The judgement falls on deeds because the covenant was given to be kept; the balance vindicates the righteous who walked in the way and exposes the sinners who deny the name of Yahuah of Spirits.
note: 60:11 was re-quoted as 60:12 by the mechanical pass; mended the prose around 'weighing' and fixed 'sinner who deny'.

title: The chambers of sun and moon: the kept orbit and the divided light
summary_md: Enoch sees the luminaries hold their appointed course and keep faith with one another: *And I saw the chambers of the sun and moon, whence they proceed and whither they come again, and their glorious return, and how one is superior to the other, and their stately orbit, and how they do not leave their orbit, and they add nothing to their orbit and they take nothing from it, and they keep faith with each other, in accordance with the oath by which they are bound together.* (1 Enoch 41:5). The sun goes out first, *And first the sun goes forth and traverses his path according to the commandment of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, and mighty is His name for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 41:6), and the moon follows her own hidden and visible path, *the one holding a position opposite to the other before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits* (1 Enoch 41:7). Then Enoch says what the lights are for: *For the sun changes oft for a blessing or a curse, And the course of the path of the moon is light to the righteous And darkness to the sinners in the name of Yahuah (Lord), Who made a separation between the light and the darkness, And divided the spirits of men, And strengthened the spirits of the righteous, In the name of His righteousness.* (1 Enoch 41:8). This is Genesis read back to us: *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* (Genesis 1:14), lights set for the appointed times, the moon *appointed... for seasons* (Psalm 104:19). Their faithful course is the guarantee Yahuah hangs the covenant on: *Thus saith Yahuah (LORD), which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night... Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name:* (Jeremiah 31:35), and the next verse says that only if those ordinances fail will the seed of Yashar'el (Israel) cease. Jubilees ties the same fourth-day lights straight to the feast calendar: *And on the fourth day He created the sun and the moon and the stars... to rule over the day and the night, and divide the light from the darkness.* (Jubilees 2:8). The luminaries keep their oath, and the feasts are appointed by the lights; that order was Torah's before it was anyone else's.
note: 41:6 'monthly revolution' was invented; 41:6-8 quoted from the live verses in full.

title: Nothing hinders His order: He appoints the judge and judges all
summary_md: Enoch closes the chapter on the lights with the reason their course never fails: *For no angel hinders and no power is able to hinder; for He appoints a judge for them all and He judges them all before Him.* (1 Enoch 41:9). The sun and moon keep faith because no created power can get between them and the commandment they run on, and the same hand that set the judge over the lights sits in judgement over men, which Enoch had already seen at the head of the chapter, *how the actions of men are weighed in the balance* (1 Enoch 41:1). The judge He appoints is named in the gospel: *For the Father judges no man, but has committed all judgment unto the Son:* (John 5:22), *And has given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of Adam.* (John 5:27). And the judgement is done before Him with the books open, the scene Enoch's own Parables show a few chapters on: *In those days I saw the Head of Days when He seated himself upon the throne of His glory, And the books of the living were opened before Him: And all His host which is in heaven above and His counsellors stood before Him,* (1 Enoch 47:3), and the scene John is shown at the end: *And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened... and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.* (Revelation 20:12). The one mediator between Elohim (God) and men is not an angel either: *For there is one Elohim (God), and one mediator between Elohim (God) and men, the man HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus);* (1 Timothy 2:5). No angel hinders the lights, no angel stands between the Father and his people, and the Son he appointed judges all.
note: The old 41:8-9 'no angel can intercede' lines are not in Charles; the live 41:9 says no angel HINDERS and He appoints a judge. Thread re-formed on that, with John 5:22/27 added from the index, 47:3 quoted in full; the 98:3 furnace tail dropped (not ch 41).

title: Wisdom finds no dwelling among men; the Son of Adam named before the stars
summary_md: The short chapter on Wisdom tells of a search that failed: *Wisdom found no place where she might dwell; Then a dwelling-place was assigned her in the heavens.* (1 Enoch 42:1), *Wisdom went forth to make her dwelling among the children of men, And found no dwelling-place: Wisdom returned to her place, And took her seat among the angels.* (1 Enoch 42:2). The Proverbs had already told us how old she is, *I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.* (Proverbs 8:23), and how men answered her, *Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;* (Proverbs 1:24). A few chapters on, Enoch sees the One in whom that Wisdom is at home, and sets his naming before the stars: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.* (1 Enoch 48:2), *Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 48:3). He is the chosen one on whom the Spirit of wisdom rests: *And the spirit of Yahuah (LORD) shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahuah (LORD);* (Isaiah 11:2). And when he came down to make his dwelling among the children of men, the reception was the one Wisdom had met: *He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.* (John 1:10), *He came unto his own, and his own received him not.* (John 1:11). Paul says plainly where Wisdom lives now, *In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.* (Colossians 2:3). The Wisdom that returned to her seat among the angels is the Wisdom named before the sun, and she came back down in the flesh of the Son of Adam.
note: 42:6 'two voices' is not in Charles (ch 42 has three verses). Re-formed on 42:1-2 with 48:2-3, Isaiah 11:2 kept; added Prov 8:23, Prov 1:24, John 1:10-11, Col 2:3 from the index; dropped Daniel 7:13 (no longer the thread's point). New title.

title: The elect dwell with Yahuah of Spirits, never separated
summary_md: Wisdom found no dwelling among the children of men and went back up, *Wisdom returned to her place, And took her seat among the angels.* (1 Enoch 42:2), but the Parables do not end there. Enoch sees the day the Elect One comes down and the righteous are settled on the earth with him: *For in those days the Elect One shall arise, And the earth shall rejoice, And the righteous shall dwell upon it, And the elect shall walk thereon.* (1 Enoch 51:5), and then the dwelling that never breaks up: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits will abide over them, And with that Son of Adam shall they eat And lie down and rise up for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 62:14). This is the gathering of a people, not a class that signed itself up. They are *the righteous and elect* who *shall be saved on that day, And they shall never thenceforward see the face of the sinners and unrighteous.* (1 Enoch 62:13). Wisdom, refused a dwelling among rebellious men, is given her resting-place in that same people: *So the Creator of all things gave me a commandment, and he that made me caused my tabernacle to rest, and said, Let your dwelling be in Jacob, and your inheritance in Yashar'el (Israel).* (Sirach 24:8). Yahusha (Jesus) names the table: *That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Luke 22:30). And the end of Revelation seals the dwelling: *And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of Elohim (God) is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and Elohim (God) himself shall be with them, and be their Elohim (God).* (Revelation 21:3). Yahuah abiding over his regathered people, eating and drinking with the Son of Adam and never parted from them again, was Enoch's hope long before John saw the new Jerusalem.
note: 42:7-8 do not exist; re-formed on 42:2 → 51:5 → 62:13-14; Sirach 24:8 and Rev 21:3 kept; Luke 22:30 added from the index.

title: The mountains leap like rams; the elect walk the earth
summary_md: Creation itself rejoices at the deliverance of the people: *And in those days shall the mountains leap like rams, And the hills also shall skip like lambs satisfied with milk, And the faces of [all] the angels in heaven shall be lighted up with joy.* (1 Enoch 51:4). That is the language of the Exodus, when Yahuah brought his people out and the hills danced: *The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.* (Psalm 114:4). Enoch takes the very figure and sets it at the second deliverance, the day the righteous come into their own: *For in those days the Elect One shall arise, And the earth shall rejoice, And the righteous shall dwell upon it, And the elect shall walk thereon.* (1 Enoch 51:5). The glory rises on that gathered remnant, *Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of Yahuah (LORD) is risen upon thee.* (Isaiah 60:1). The leaping mountains of the redeemed Yashar'el (Israel) in the Psalm are the leaping mountains of the day the Elect One arises in Enoch, and the same earth that danced for the first exodus will dance for the gathering.
note: 42:9 does not exist; the words live at 51:4. Re-cited, 51:5 added, closing line reworked (the old one named 42:9). Title adjusted to the live verse.

title: Wisdom withdrawn, unrighteousness welcomed: the two dwellings
summary_md: The chapter on Wisdom closes with her rival moving into the house she was refused: *And unrighteousness went forth from her chambers: Whom she sought not she found, And dwelt with them, As rain in a desert And dew on a thirsty land.* (1 Enoch 42:3). Wisdom had gone out to the children of men and *found no dwelling-place: Wisdom returned to her place, And took her seat among the angels.* (1 Enoch 42:2). The Proverbs say the same thing about the same refusal, in Wisdom's own voice: *Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;* (Proverbs 1:24), and the cost of it, *Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:* (Proverbs 1:28). Yahusha (Jesus) stood over the city and said the same: *O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!* (Matthew 23:37). Unrighteousness does not have to go looking; she is taken in like rain on a desert, because a people that has turned Wisdom out is thirsty for whatever comes next. The two dwellings Enoch describes are the two houses every generation chooses between, and the house that will not have Wisdom will have her rival.
note: 42:10-11 do not exist; the old thought (righteous shining) belongs to ch 39/38 and is carried by thread 3180. Rebuilt this thread on the live 42:3, the one verse of the chapter no thread covered; Prov 1:24/1:28 and Matt 23:37 from the index. New title.

title: Weighed in measure, number, and order
summary_md: Enoch sees not only that the stars are named but that they are measured: *And I saw how they are weighed in a righteous balance according to their proportions of light: (I saw) the width of their spaces and the day of their appearing, and how their revolution produces lightning: and (I saw) their revolution according to the number of the angels, and (how) they keep faith with each other.* (1 Enoch 43:2). The Elohim who orders the lights by weight and number is the one who answers Job out of the whirlwind, *Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?* (Job 38:33), and who binds the constellations, *Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?* (Job 38:31). The Wisdom of Solomon names the principle outright: the Creator *have ordered all things in measure and number and weight.* (Wisdom of Solomon 11:20), and Enoch's balance is that same ordering seen from inside the heavens. The lights run by exact decree, their spaces and their days of appearing fixed, and they keep faith with each other; this is the canon's own cosmos of set weight and number, not a pagan astrology.
note: prose mended: 'the change of the months' is not in the live 43:2; now 'their spaces and their days of appearing'.

title: The stars keep faith with each other, and they are the names of the holy
summary_md: Enoch is shown the stars kept to their measure: *And I saw how they are weighed in a righteous balance according to their proportions of light: (I saw) the width of their spaces and the day of their appearing, and how their revolution produces lightning: and (I saw) their revolution according to the number of the angels, and (how) they keep faith with each other.* (1 Enoch 43:2). He had already told the reader at the head of the book to look up and learn from that faithfulness: *Observe ye everything that takes place in the heaven, how they do not change their orbits, and the luminaries which are in the heaven, how they all rise and set in order each in its season, and transgress not against their appointed order.* (1 Enoch 2:1). Then he asks what the stars are, and the answer turns the lesson on the reader: *And he said to me: ‘Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath showed thee their parabolic meaning (lit. 'their parable'): these are the names of the holy who dwell on the earth and believe in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits for ever and ever.’* (1 Enoch 43:4). Yahuah hangs his covenant with his people on this same order: *Thus saith Yahuah (LORD), which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name:* (Jeremiah 31:35), *Thus saith Yahuah (LORD); If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth; Then will I cast away the seed of Jacob* (Jeremiah 33:25). The stars that keep their appointed order and keep faith with each other are a parable of the holy who keep the name of Yahuah of Spirits, and the seed of Jacob is as sure as the ordinances they run on.
note: 43:3-4 'return to their place / do not turn aside' were invented; the live 43:3-4 is the parable (the stars are the names of the holy). Thread re-formed on 43:2, 2:1, 43:4; Jeremiah witnesses kept.

title: The winds that uphold and stretch out the heavens
summary_md: Enoch sees the beams and pillars that hold creation steady: *And I saw the corner-stone of the earth: I saw the four winds which bear [the earth and] the firmament of the heaven.* (1 Enoch 18:2), and *And I saw how the winds stretch out the vaults of heaven, and have their station between heaven and earth: these are the pillars of the heaven.* (1 Enoch 18:3). The Tanakh sets the same foundations and corner-stone by the Maker's hand: *Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.* (Job 38:4), *Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;* (Job 38:6). The same Elohim *hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion* and stirs the winds Enoch is watching: *When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.* (Jeremiah 10:13). Enoch's stretched vaults and wind-pillars are the canon's stretched-out heavens and founded pillars; the world is a built house, and he was shown the beams.
note: 43:6-7 do not exist; the words live at 18:2-3 (already re-cited); prose smoothed.

title: He furnished the whole creation with the winds and called the stars by name
summary_md: Enoch's tour of the storehouses begins with the winds and what they hold up: *I saw the treasuries of all the winds: I saw how He had furnished with them the whole creation and the firm foundations of the earth.* (1 Enoch 18:1). Later he sees the same storehouses from the inside: *And there are preserved the voices of the thunder and the light of the lightnings: and there are preserved the chambers of the hail and the chambers of the hoar-frost, and the chambers of the mist, and the chambers of the rain and the dew.* (1 Enoch 69:23). And he sees the Creator naming his stars one by one: *And I saw other lightnings and the stars of heaven, and I saw how He called them all by their names and they hearkened unto Him.* (1 Enoch 43:1). Isaiah says it the same way: *Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who hath created these things, that bringeth out their host by number: he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that he is strong in power; not one faileth.* (Isaiah 40:26). The founding by wisdom is Jeremiah's word for the same work, *He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion.* (Jeremiah 10:12), and Wisdom herself was there *When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:* (Proverbs 8:28). The storehouses Enoch is walked past are the ones Yahuah asks Job about, *Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail* (Job 38:22), and Jubilees keeps the same inventory from the first day, *the angels of the spirit of the clouds, and of darkness, and of snow and of hail* (Jubilees 2:2). The world Enoch saw furnished with the winds and the stars he heard answer to their names are the same world and the same stars the prophets praise, and the order he saw in the heavens is the order their Maker asks of his people.
note: 43:12-13 do not exist; re-formed on 18:1, 69:23, 43:1 with Isaiah 40:26 from the index; Jer 10:12, Prov 8:28, Job 38:22, Jub 2:2 kept; dropped Prov 3:19 (not in the index). Title adjusted.

title: The closed chambers — where the lights, winds, and waters proceed
summary_md: Enoch is shown the hidden storehouses of creation: *And there mine eyes saw the secrets of the lightning and of the thunder, and the secrets of the winds, how they are divided to blow over the earth, and the secrets of the clouds and dew, and there I saw from whence they proceed in that place and from whence they saturate the dusty earth.* (1 Enoch 41:3), *And there I saw closed chambers out of which the winds are divided, the chamber of the hail and winds, the chamber of the mist, and of the clouds, and the cloud thereof hovers over the earth from the beginning of the world.* (1 Enoch 41:4). The lightnings have a chamber too, and some of the stars go into it: *Also another phenomenon I saw in regard to the lightnings: how some of the stars arise and become lightnings and cannot part with their new form.* (1 Enoch 44:1). This is the catechism Yahuah puts to Job out of the whirlwind, *Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we are?* (Job 38:35), the Maker alone knowing the way to the dwelling of the light and the chambers of the wind. Enoch had already seen the chambers of the two great lights, *And I saw the chambers of the sun and moon, whence they proceed and whither they come again, and their glorious return, and how one is superior to the other, and their stately orbit, and how they do not leave their orbit, and they add nothing to their orbit and they take nothing from it, and they keep faith with each other, in accordance with the oath by which they are bound together.* (1 Enoch 41:5), and the whole book of the luminaries opens on the same showing: *The book of the courses of the luminaries of the heaven, the relations of each, according to their classes, their dominion and their seasons, according to their names and places of origin, and according to their months, which Uriel, the holy angel, who was with me, who is their guide, showed me; and he showed me all their laws exactly as they are, and how it is with regard to all the years of the world and unto eternity, till the new creation is accomplished which dureth till eternity.* (1 Enoch 72:1). The point of the tour is not science but who holds the keys: the one who keeps the lightning in its chamber is the one who judges men.
note: 44:1-2 re-cited to 41:3-4 (where the words live), the live 44:1 quoted, 72:1 quoted in full from the live text.

title: In accordance with an oath they set and rise — the unbroken ordinance of heaven
summary_md: The sun and moon hold their station by covenant, not by chance: *And I saw the chambers of the sun and moon, whence they proceed and whither they come again, and their glorious return, and how one is superior to the other, and their stately orbit, and how they do not leave their orbit, and they add nothing to their orbit and they take nothing from it, and they keep faith with each other, in accordance with the oath by which they are bound together.* (1 Enoch 41:5). The moon has her own path in the same bond: *And after that I saw the hidden and the visible path of the moon, and she accomplishes the course of her path in that place by day and by night—the one holding a position opposite to the other before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits. And they give thanks and praise and rest not; For unto them is their thanksgiving rest.* (1 Enoch 41:7). Yahuah binds his own faithfulness to this ordinance: *Thus saith Yahuah (LORD); If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth* (Jeremiah 33:25). The lights were set as a sworn timepiece from the start, *let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years* (Genesis 1:14), and their silent obedience is itself a testimony: *The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament sheweth his handywork* (Psalm 19:1). Jubilees reads the same decree as the appointing of the feasts: *And Elohim (God) appointed the sun to be a great sign on the earth for days and for sabbaths and for months and for feasts and for years* (Jubilees 2:9). The luminaries keep their oath, and so the appointed times stand.
note: 44:3-4 do not exist; words live at 41:5 and 41:7 (re-cited mechanically); prose joined up.

title: He made a separation between the light and the darkness — and between the spirits
summary_md: The same word that splits day from night also parts the righteous from the sinner: *For the sun changes oft for a blessing or a curse, And the course of the path of the moon is light to the righteous And darkness to the sinners in the name of Yahuah (Lord), Who made a separation between the light and the darkness, And divided the spirits of men, And strengthened the spirits of the righteous, In the name of His righteousness.* (1 Enoch 41:8). This is creation's first separation: *And Elohim (God) saw the light, that it was good: and Elohim (God) divided the light from the darkness* (Genesis 1:4), and the lights themselves were set *to divide the light from the darkness: and Elohim (God) saw that it was good* (Genesis 1:18). Enoch reads that first separation all the way down into men. The Maker who parted light from dark also divided the spirits of men and strengthened the spirits of the righteous, and he did it in the name of his own righteousness, before any of them had done a thing. The righteous are a people set apart by his separation, not a class that sorted itself out, and the hand that fixed the luminaries is the hand that drew the line.
note: 44:5 does not exist; words live at 41:8 (re-cited); prose mended around 'separation'.

title: Stars that become lightnings and cannot part with their new form
summary_md: The one line of this chapter describes a change that does not reverse: *Also another phenomenon I saw in regard to the lightnings: how some of the stars arise and become lightnings and cannot part with their new form.* (1 Enoch 44:1). The angel had just told Enoch what the stars are: *And he said to me: ‘Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath showed thee their parabolic meaning (lit. 'their parable'): these are the names of the holy who dwell on the earth and believe in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits for ever and ever.’* (1 Enoch 43:4). So the stars that rise and become lightnings are the holy, taken up into a brighter form they can never lose. Daniel saw the same rising: *And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.* (Daniel 12:3), and Yahusha (Jesus) set it at the harvest: *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* (Matthew 13:43). Paul names the change and its moment: *In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.* (1 Corinthians 15:52), and its shape, *Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.* (Philippians 3:21). The holy who become lightnings do not go back to being what they were. Enoch saw the resurrection body from the sky's side.
note: 44:6-7 'no angel can intercede' do not exist (ch 44 has one verse); that thought is carried by thread 3191 on 41:9. Rebuilt on 44:1 with 43:4, Daniel 12:3, Matt 13:43, 1 Cor 15:52, Phil 3:21 (index). New title.

title: Changed from glory to glory: the new form is kept
summary_md: Enoch watches some of the stars pass into lightning and stay there: *Also another phenomenon I saw in regard to the lightnings: how some of the stars arise and become lightnings and cannot part with their new form.* (1 Enoch 44:1). Since the stars in this vision are *the names of the holy who dwell on the earth and believe in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits for ever and ever* (1 Enoch 43:4), the picture is of a people being changed, and the change holding. Paul describes the same thing happening now, before the trumpet: *But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.* (2 Corinthians 3:18), and then finished at the end: *In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.* (1 Corinthians 15:52). Daniel puts the two outcomes of that day side by side, *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt* (Daniel 12:2), and the ones who rise to life *shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.* (Daniel 12:3). A star that has become lightning is not going back to being a star. The holy who are raised incorruptible are not going back to corruption, and that is the hope this one short chapter keeps.
note: 44:8 furnace quote does not exist (it is 38:1's thought). Rebuilt on 44:1 (the only verse of ch 44) from the side of the kept change, with 2 Cor 3:18, 1 Cor 15:52, Daniel 12:2-3 (index). New title. NOTE: 3206 and 3207 now both sit on the single verse of ch 44 — one could be retired.

title: The Elect One on the throne of glory tries their works
summary_md: The second Parable opens with judgement already seated: *On that day Mine Elect One shall sit on the throne of glory And shall try their works, And their places of rest shall be innumerable. And their souls shall grow strong within them when they see Mine elect ones, And those who have called upon My glorious name:* (1 Enoch 45:3). The Elect One is the Formed Son, set under the Head of Days and placed on the throne by him, which Enoch says again plainly later on: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8), and *And the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, And his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel: For Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath given (them) to him and hath glorified him.* (1 Enoch 51:3). When Yahusha (Jesus) says *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:* (Matthew 25:31), and *in the regeneration when the Son of Adam shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Matthew 19:28), the gospel is not coining a phrase; it is taking up Enoch's own. Daniel sees the same figure and keeps the comparison, *one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days* (Daniel 7:13), like a man because he would take flesh while remaining the Formed one who rides the clouds, and Enoch names that same one on the throne.
note: 62:1 re-cited to 61:8 mechanically; 'seated' in the prose now matches 'placed'; closing smoothed.

title: Heaven and earth transformed for the elect to dwell
summary_md: Judgement in this Parable is not the end of the story but the clearing of the ground for a renewal: *Then will I cause Mine Elect One to dwell among them. And I will transform the heaven and make it an eternal blessing and light:* (1 Enoch 45:4), *And I will transform the earth and make it a blessing: And I will cause Mine elect ones to dwell upon it: But the sinners and evil-doers shall not set foot thereon.* (1 Enoch 45:5). This is the Tanakh's own promise in Enoch's mouth: *For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.* (Isaiah 65:17), and *For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith Yahuah (LORD), so shall your seed and your name remain.* (Isaiah 66:22), where the renewal is tied to a seed and a name, not to whoever happens to be standing there. John sees it finished: *And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.* (Revelation 21:1), *And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from Elohim (God) out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.* (Revelation 21:2), *And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of Elohim (God) is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and Elohim (God) himself shall be with them, and be their Elohim (God).* (Revelation 21:3). The Elect One dwelling among his people on a transformed earth is exactly what Enoch was told. Jubilees ties the renewed creation to the same people: *from the day of the new creation when the heavens and the earth shall be renewed... and all the luminaries be renewed... for all the elect of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Jubilees 1:29). The transformed heaven and earth are for the elect to dwell on, the covenant people brought home, and Enoch adds the line the pulpit leaves out, that the sinners and evil-doers shall not set foot there.
note: 45:4 re-quoted from the live verse (old words were a paraphrase), 45:5 added; canon witnesses kept.

title: The chosen righteous, named and gathered
summary_md: The second Parable is announced against a particular people, *those who deny the name of the dwelling of the holy ones and Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits* (1 Enoch 45:1), and it ends with a choosing: *And he shall choose the righteous and holy from among them: For the day has drawn nigh that they should be saved.* (1 Enoch 51:2). Enoch grounds that choosing before the worlds. The Elect One himself was named before creation: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.* (1 Enoch 48:2), *Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 48:3), *And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.* (1 Enoch 48:6). That is the Word John opens his gospel with, and the Lamb Revelation calls slain from the foundation of the world. The names of the righteous are likewise already on record when the court sits: *In those days I saw the Head of Days when He seated himself upon the throne of His glory, And the books of the living were opened before Him: And all His host which is in heaven above and His counsellors stood before Him,* (1 Enoch 47:3). The Servant of Isaiah carries the same word: *Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.* (Isaiah 42:1). The elect are a people chosen and written down before they ever heard the call, and the hearing shows what was already true of them. The choosing comes first; the answering reveals it.
note: 45:12 does not exist (words at 51:2); 45:1's phrase was mis-cited to 46:7 by the grader — the live 45:1 carries 'deny the name' itself, used that; 47:3 quoted in full.

title: The sinners shall not set foot on the transformed earth
summary_md: Against the renewed dwelling of the elect stands the sinners' lot: *And I will transform the earth and make it a blessing: And I will cause Mine elect ones to dwell upon it: But the sinners and evil-doers shall not set foot thereon.* (1 Enoch 45:5), *For I have provided and satisfied with peace My righteous ones And have caused them to dwell before Me: But for the sinners there is judgement impending with Me, So that I shall destroy them from the face of the earth.* (1 Enoch 45:6). Enoch had already said where they go instead, *And into the heaven they shall not ascend, And on the earth they shall not come: Such shall be the lot of the sinners Who have denied the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, Who are thus preserved for the day of suffering and tribulation.* (1 Enoch 45:2). The day that does it is Malachi's: *For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.* (Malachi 4:1). Yahusha (Jesus) sets the same two ends side by side: *And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.* (Matthew 13:42), *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* (Matthew 13:43). The Wisdom of Solomon paints it the same way, the righteous flaming out over the stubble: *And in the time of their visitation they shall shine, and run to and fro like sparks among the stubble.* (Wisdom of Solomon 3:7), *They shall judge the nations, and have dominion over the people, and their Elohim (God) shall reign for ever.* (Wisdom of Solomon 3:8). The transformed earth is kept for the righteous, and the sinners are destroyed from the face of it before the elect are set down on it.
note: 45:5 'straw in the fire' is 48:9's thought and not in ch 45; rebuilt on the live 45:5-6 and 45:2; the 50:2 mechanical insert dropped (not this chapter); canon witnesses kept. Title adjusted.

title: The kings and the mighty cast down from their thrones
summary_md: The second Parable is spoken against the high seats of the earth, *those who deny the name of the dwelling of the holy ones and Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits* (1 Enoch 45:1), and the next chapter names the one who brings them down: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4), *[And he shall put down the kings from their thrones and kingdoms] Because they do not extol and praise Him, Nor humbly acknowledge whence the kingdom was bestowed upon them.* (1 Enoch 46:5), and their end, *And he shall put down the countenance of the strong, And shall fill them with shame. And darkness shall be their dwelling, And worms shall be their bed, And they shall have no hope of rising from their beds, Because they do not extol the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 46:6). John sees the same terror take hold of them: *And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;* (Revelation 6:15), *For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?* (Revelation 6:17). The Branch of Isaiah judges with the same rod: *But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.* (Isaiah 11:4), and the enthroned Son breaks the proud thrones, *Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.* (Psalm 2:9). The charge against the kings is not that they ruled but that they would not acknowledge whose kingdom they held. The thrones of the proud come down, and the meek are vindicated.
note: 45:7 does not exist; re-formed on 45:1 and 46:4-6 (46:6 added); canon witnesses kept.

title: The earth and Sheol give back the dead
summary_md: At the height of the Parable the dead come back: *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.* (1 Enoch 51:1), and Enoch names the one who sorts the risen: *And he shall choose the righteous and holy from among them: For the day has drawn nigh that they should be saved.* (1 Enoch 51:2). This is the canon's whole resurrection chorus: *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* (Daniel 12:2), *Thy dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.* (Isaiah 26:19), and Yahusha's (Jesus's) own voice over the graves: *Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,* (John 5:28), *And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.* (John 5:29). Esdras joins the witness: *And the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her, and so shall the dust those that dwell in silence, and the secret places shall deliver those souls that were committed to them.* (2 Esdras 7:32). The earth gives back what was entrusted to it, the righteous are chosen from among the risen, and then, Enoch says, *the Elect One shall arise, And the earth shall rejoice* (1 Enoch 51:5).
note: 45:11 does not exist; the duplicated 51:1 collapsed to one quote, 51:2 and 51:5 added; 'elect' prose mended.

title: They deny the name and persecute His congregations
summary_md: The chapter closes on the indictment of the mighty: *And these are they who judge the stars of heaven, [And raise their hands against the El Elyon (Most High)], And tread upon the earth and dwell upon it. And all their deeds manifest unrighteousness, And their power rests upon their riches, And their faith is in the gods which they have made with their hands, And they deny the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits,* (1 Enoch 46:7), *And they persecute the houses of His congregations, And the faithful who hang upon the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 46:8). The root of it is the denial the Psalm names: *The fool hath said in his heart, There is no Elohim (God). They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good* (Psalm 14:1). The Wisdom of Solomon puts the persecution in the persecutors' own mouths: *Therefore let us lie in wait for the righteous; because he is not for our turn, and he is clean contrary to our doings: he upbraideth us with our offending the law* (Wisdom of Solomon 2:12). Those who hang upon the Father's name are hunted because they keep his way, and the lawless cannot bear the sight of it. The judgement Enoch saw coming on those who deny the name is the one Paul preaches: *when the Lord Yahusha (Lord Jesus) shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels, In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not Elohim (God), and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Lord Jesus Christ)* (2 Thessalonians 1:7–8). The faithful who hang upon the name are the covenant remnant, a people who keep the Father's name and his Torah, and their persecutors' bed of worms and dwelling of darkness (1 Enoch 46:6) is sure for one reason Enoch gives twice: they would not extol that name.
note: 46:9/46:10 do not exist; words at 46:7-8, both quoted in full; prose joined.

title: The Son of Adam named in the presence of the Head of Days
summary_md: Here Enoch names the one Daniel only glimpsed: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.* (1 Enoch 48:2). Daniel sees the same figure and keeps the comparison: *I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.* (Daniel 7:13). Daniel says one like the Son of Adam, because the Formed Son would take on flesh and look like a man while remaining the one who rides the clouds; Enoch names that very one, and to him is given the kingdom Daniel records: *And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.* (Daniel 7:14). The same chosen pre-eminence sounds earlier in the Parables: *This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him, and whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (God) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3), and at the throne of glory he is set in his place: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.* (1 Enoch 61:8). The Head of Days is the Father, formless; the Son of Adam is the Formed Son, ordered under him and named before him, not a second co-equal person, not a mere man, not a created angel, but the Messiah who came as Yahusha (Jesus).
note: 62:1 re-cited to 61:8 (mechanical); 'named once more' changed to 'set in his place' to match the live verb 'placed'.

title: The change for the holy and elect: light and glory turned upon them
summary_md: Enoch opens the chapter with the turning of the age for Yahuah's people: *And in those days a change shall take place for the holy and elect, And the light of days shall abide upon them, And glory and honour shall turn to the holy* (1 Enoch 50:1). This is not a class earning a reward; it is the elect already named in the chapters before, now vindicated. Malachi binds the same dawn to the fear of his name: *But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall* (Malachi 4:2). The change is the patient verdict of an Elohim of judgement: *And therefore will Yahuah (LORD) wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for Yahuah (LORD) is a Elohim (God) of judgment: blessed are all they that wait for him* (Isaiah 30:18). Daniel sees the resurrection glory that the light of days is reaching toward: *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt* (Daniel 12:2). And Enoch's next chapter names the choosing under which the change comes: *And he shall choose the righteous and holy from among them: For the day has drawn nigh that they should be saved.* (1 Enoch 51:2). The Elect One, the Formed Son ordered under the Head of Days, chooses the righteous and holy out of the risen and turns the light of days upon Yashar'el's (Israel's) gathered remnant, a people that was chosen before it was called.
note: 51:2 mechanically re-quoted; prose mended ('the One under whom' → the choosing), closing line joined up.

title: His righteous judgement: the unrepentant perish before Him
summary_md: The chapter closes on the limit of the mercy that was offered. Repentance was held out, *That they may repent And forgo the works of their hands* (1 Enoch 50:2), and for those who refuse it the door shuts: *And He is righteous also in His judgement, And in the presence of His glory unrighteousness also shall not maintain itself: At His judgement the unrepentant shall perish before Him* (1 Enoch 50:4), *And from henceforth I will have no mercy on them, saith Yahuah (God) of Spirits* (1 Enoch 50:5). Malachi pictures the same burning day for the proud: *For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that it shall leave them neither root nor branch* (Malachi 4:1). Isaiah names the salvation that was refused, the returning and rest the unrepentant would not take: *For thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel); In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not* (Isaiah 30:15). Paul gathers the impenitent into that same day: *But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of Elohim (God)* (Romans 2:5). And Enoch sets this judgement after the dead are raised: *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.* (1 Enoch 51:1), with the Elect One choosing the righteous and holy from among them. The judgement is righteous because it is the Father's order upheld through the Formed Son. The mercy was great and it was real, and it ends only where repentance is finally refused.
note: 51:1 mechanically re-quoted; 50:2 quoted rather than cited bare; prose joined.

title: All in the graves shall hear his voice and come forth
summary_md: Enoch joins the resurrection to the Elect One himself: *And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.* (1 Enoch 51:1), *And he shall choose the righteous and holy from among them: For the day has drawn nigh that they should be saved.* (1 Enoch 51:2). The Son of Adam whom Enoch's angel names, *This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3), is the one Yahusha (Jesus) says will raise and judge the dead by his own voice: *And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of Adam.* (John 5:27), *Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,* (John 5:28), *And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.* (John 5:29). Enoch's choosing of the righteous from among them is this same twofold raising, life for some and damnation for others. And Ezekiel had already promised the opened graves to a people, not to a class that picked itself: *Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Ezekiel 37:12), the whole house of Yashar'el (Israel) brought up and gathered home.
note: 51:1 restored (the mechanical pass had collapsed it to 51:2); 46:3 quoted in full instead of the bare 'names'.

title: The stone cut without hands — the kingdom that does not avail by metal
summary_md: The angel tells Enoch what the mountains of metal come to in the day of the Elect One: *And it shall come to pass in those days that none shall be saved, Either by gold or by silver, And none be able to escape.* (1 Enoch 52:7), *And all these things shall be [denied and] destroyed from the surface of the earth, When the Elect One shall appear before the face of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 52:9). Daniel had been told the same secret with a stone: *Thou sawest till that a stone was cut out without hands, which smote the image upon his feet that were of iron and clay, and brake them to pieces.* (Daniel 2:34), and then *the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth* (Daniel 2:35). The interpretation seals it: *Forasmuch as thou sawest that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it brake in pieces the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver, and the gold; the great Elohim (God) hath made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter: and the dream is certain, and the interpretation thereof sure.* (Daniel 2:45). What Daniel sees as a stone no hand cut breaking the metals, Enoch sees as the Elect One before whom the same metals are made powerless. The kingdom that stands is the one given everlasting dominion, and Daniel sees its king as a man while Enoch names him: *I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.* (Daniel 7:13). Daniel beholds one like the Son of Adam, because the Formed Son took on flesh and looked like a man, and Enoch names that same Elect One outright. To him *was given dominion, and glory, and a kingdom* (Daniel 7:14), the stone kingdom that no metal of empire outlasts.
note: READ: gloss fit the live ch 52; added the live 52:7 and 52:9 so Enoch is quoted, not just described; 'Keep the kaph' instruction-voice removed.

title: The six mountains of metal melt before the Elect One
summary_md: Enoch is borne west and shown the secret things of heaven that shall be: *There mine eyes saw all the secret things of heaven that shall be, a mountain of iron, and a mountain of copper, and a mountain of silver, and a mountain of gold, and a mountain of soft metal, and a mountain of lead.* (1 Enoch 52:2). These are the metals of empire, and the angel says what becomes of them: *And these mountains which thine eyes have seen, The mountain of iron, and the mountain of copper, and the mountain of silver, And the mountain of gold, and the mountain of soft metal, and the mountain of lead, All these shall be in the presence of the Elect One As wax before the fire, And like the water which streams down from above [upon those mountains], And they shall become powerless before his feet.* (1 Enoch 52:6). The same metals stand in Nebuchadnezzar's image, and the same fate overtakes them: *Then was the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold, broken to pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors; and the wind carried them away, that no place was found for them: and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.* (Daniel 2:35). The mountains of metal that melt in Enoch are Daniel's kingdoms of metal that shatter, and the Elect One before whom they go powerless is the stone kingdom that stands for ever: *And in the days of these kings shall the Elohim (God) of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people, but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever.* (Daniel 2:44). Enoch tells you the melting and the prophets tell you the cause: *And the mountains shall be molten under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, and as the waters that are poured down a steep place.* (Micah 1:4), *The hills melted like wax at the presence of Yahuah (LORD), at the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of the whole earth.* (Psalm 97:5). No weight of gold or iron stands by its own might before the Formed Son.
note: 52:3 re-cited to 52:6 (mechanical); prose around 'these things' mended.
